review_type: Independent static source and test review; no implementation edits or execution.

findings.finding: A causal/postfit availability bit paired with a nonfinite forecast/fit merely removes that voltage diagnostic. The row can remain transaction_valid and completed_valid_arm can remain true. The elapsed clock is only required to increase, so an incorrect finite time increment is accepted.
findings.source_evidence: transaction_valid excludes only return/flags, unknown mask and nonfinite SOC/Q/old weights. causal_ok and fit_ok separately test finite outputs without invalidating the transaction. elapsed<=last_elapsed is the only clock relationship check.
findings.concrete_fix: Record an invalid-transaction issue when an asserted available voltage field is nonfinite. Require each accepted chronological clock value to equal the previous clock plus actual dt using the same binary64 addition semantics; preserve the bad row and first issue.
findings.targeted_qualification: Extend a fabricated scoring fixture with an asserted available NaN forecast/fit and a finite but incorrect elapsed increment; both must fail complete-valid accounting.

findings.finding: Scalar completeness does not require the mandatory full-query grid or its endpoint. An initial-only query file with a complete scalar stream can be labeled completed_valid_arm=true. Queries beyond the consumed cursor are also accepted and scored if matching truth exists.
findings.source_evidence: full_query_scores iterates whatever rows json_rows returns, checks monotonicity and a record cap, but never compares row indices to a required grid or last_consumed_index. last_consumed_index is used only for selecting a summary detail.
findings.concrete_fix: Accept exact required_query_indices from the root or derive the frozen grid. Require each scheduled index through the actual consumed endpoint plus initial/restore and required failure entry; explicitly reject out-of-arm/future rows. Preserve the intended arm horizon for incomplete scalar windows.
findings.targeted_qualification: Fabricated tests should remove a required interior/final query and add a query beyond the observed cursor; neither input may retain complete-valid status.

contract: failure_stops.immediate: nonfinite state or required available output
findings.finding: A nonfinite nuisance state coordinate with finite Q/SOC silently suppresses the entire natural-vector contribution. A malformed/nonfinite mean in an existing full-truth row similarly yields full_truth_available=false but is not classified as missing full16 truth. Asserted available local ranges with nonfinite or reversed bounds are silently reclassified as unavailable. These cases can leave completed_valid_arm=true.
findings.source_evidence: raw_centers validates only length, then uses coordinates5/11. natural returns None for any nonfinite coordinate; full_query_scores skips nd without adding an integrity issue. RangeAudit.add ignores invalid available bounds. Only absent full-truth rows populate missing_full.
findings.concrete_fix: Validate all16 mandatory state and full-truth coordinates and flag malformed required vectors as scoring-invalid. Require finite ordered interval bounds when local_ranges_available is asserted. Keep legitimate unavailable interval/SD placeholders explicitly unavailable instead of imposing finiteness on unavailable outputs.
findings.targeted_qualification: Use fabricated corrupt query/truth vectors and an asserted available malformed interval; none may produce completed_valid_arm=true or silently lose an expected vector score.

findings.finding: For a learned phase entry already available and inside target, first_observed_hit skips the entry and reports the next passing interval. In the same case sustained can correctly point to the entry. This makes the two onset fields inconsistent unless first_observed_hit is intentionally interval-only.
findings.concrete_fix: Expose entry-inclusive first attainment for learned phase boundaries, or retain the interval-only field with an explicit additional entry-inclusive result. Initial and cold-reset raw priors must remain excluded from learned attainment.

reviewed_as_sound: Raw SOC/Q centers come from mean[11] and exp(mean[5]); unavailable convenience zeros are not used as estimates.
Every observed scalar interval enters targets; unavailable/invalid rows cannot pass, and scheduled-sample denominators include the unobserved tail.
Tail-pass logic implements sustained accuracy through the declared finite endpoint and censors incomplete windows.
Retention checks both entry and later interval ends. Preferred accuracy may drift inside the target and still count as retained.
Weak/rest B subphases are entry-aware, and scoring retains the frozen intended endpoints after an early stop.
Causal forecast error against clean voltage, observed-minus-forecast innovation, and filtered postfit error are distinct reducers with correct signs.
Binary truth/observation joins use global indices and support nonzero suffixes with a whole A truth file.
Natural-unit mapping exponentiates the first6 coordinates and retains physical units for the remaining10; positive-parameter relative errors cover coordinates0..10.
Component comparison and oracle-best diagnostics are post-scoring only; runtime output selection is not altered.
Range inclusion is explicitly descriptive serial-sample inclusion, without calibrated coverage or hard-support claims.
Normal scoring uses constant-size reducers, indexed binary reads and streamed deterministic gzip, with only selected query details retained.
Malformed/truncated indexed binary records, duplicate/nonmonotone JSON indices, rejected flags even on return0, and exclusive output policy are handled explicitly.

test_review.scope: Small fabricated fixtures with no generator, RNG or learner calls.
covered: weighted means/RMS and first tied peak
entry retention and drift inside preferred
raw prior vs placeholders and three voltage diagnostics
partial metric record and output exclusivity
coverage_gaps_for_findings: S1 available nonfinite voltage and incorrect finite clock
S2 required full-query grid, endpoint, out-of-range queries
S3 corrupt mandatory full vectors and asserted available malformed ranges
test_review.execution_statement: No tests were run as part of this independent review.

bounded_memory_note: The ordinary valid-input path is streaming. Detailed issue and missing-full lists can grow for corrupt inputs, up to fixed study record bounds; this review does not establish a measured RSS claim. The root resource monitor remains responsible for the frozen process/output limits.
disposition: Address S1-S3 before executable freeze or primary scoring qualification. Resolve S4 semantics explicitly. Suggested fabricated qualifications are recommendations to the owner, not additional executed tests.
